summary: Colville National Forest tower with a 1964 R-6 cab on a 10-foot base; the site has had four lookouts since 1927, was last staffed in 1976, and was refurbished by 2022.

facts.design: R-6 flat cab on a 10-foot treated timber tower

access.note: Reached by a forest road that TrailChick says runs to the summit; the cab sits on National Forest land. No source we read says whether the cab is open for visitors to enter.

visit.trail_note: A 2018 visit report says the road suits a pickup or a car with a little extra clearance.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The record's 10.7 m (about 35 ft) matches the 35-foot pole tower of 1927 in firelookout. The present structure is a 10-foot tower per the register, firelookout and TrailChick, so facts.height_m is set to 3.0.

1927 is the first lookout on the site; 1964 is the present R-6 cab. The register, firelookout and TrailChick give 1964; the 2018 tDAR study gives 1965 for the same cab, and that disagreement is not resolved by the sources read.

notes_for_editor: Build year disagrees: 1964 in the register, firelookout and TrailChick, 1965 in the 2018 tDAR study; story states both. Record height_m 10.7 looks like the 1927 pole tower (35 ft); facts.height_m set to 3.0 for the present 10-foot tower, please confirm the cab-floor height. The 2018 visit report on the register says Staffed? No, and the 2018 TrailChick visit says last staffed 1976; no later staffing source found. No current rental or open-to-visitors information found; the 2022 Forest Service project page does not say the cab is open. Access note is inferred from road-access statements, not from a Forest Service visitor page. The 2017 restoration partner is named only as FFLA in TrailChick; no expansion was found in any source read, so the story keeps the acronym.
